headline: A 2022 law renames a Minneapolis Postal Service facility the Charles W. Lindberg Post Office.
what_it_does: The law officially names the United States Postal Service facility at 825 West 65th Street in Minneapolis, Minnesota, the Charles W. Lindberg Post Office. It does not change how mail is handled, what services the office offers, or who works there. The name is an honorary designation.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 27, 2022.
